Class ViewAddLesson

java.lang.Object
guiAddLesson.ViewAddLesson
public class ViewAddLesson extends Object

Title: ViewAddLesson Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Add Lesson Page. A contributor enters a new lesson's core information (title, category, situation, and lesson text) and saves it (Contributor story 1). Each field shows its limits next to its label, and an invalid entry produces the LessonRecognizer's specific message in red with the cursor placed in that field.

The layout follows the team's User Experience document and the My Lessons page: a light background, breadcrumb and bold title, fields grouped in a bordered card with labels above them, a blue button for the main action, and a bottom row of plain buttons.

Copyright: Joshua Luther © 2026

      private ViewAddLesson()

      Description: This method initializes all the elements of the graphical user interface. This method determines the location, size, font, color, and change and event handlers for each GUI object. This is a singleton and is only performed once.

  • Method Details

    • displayAddLesson

      public static void displayAddLesson(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)

      Method: displayAddLesson(Stage ps, User user)

      Description: This method is the single entry point from outside this package to cause the Add Lesson page to be displayed. It sets up the shared attributes, builds the page the first time, and empties the form every time, because the page is a singleton and an earlier, unsaved lesson must not reappear.

      Parameters:
      ps - specifies the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and it's methods
      user - specifies the User for this GUI and it's methods
